_comment: Halden Distribution Ltd. — P9 Uptime Kuma monitor definitions. Applies to OPS01 (Kuma container, https://kuma.halden.internal). Uptime Kuma is installed in P9 specifically so P8 gets a backup heartbeat: a PUSH monitor that the backup job calls after a successful restore test. Tokens are NOT stored here — they are created in the Kuma UI and the push URL is kept in the git-ignored .env / password manager. Targets are lab-internal only.

monitor_defaults.notification: email-to-team-placeholder (configured in the UI; no credentials in the repo)

monitors.name: Backup heartbeat - P8 weekly restore test
monitors.schedule: expected every Sunday 03:00 after the P8 restore test
monitors.purpose: A PUSH monitor that the P8 restore-test job pings on success; a missed ping raises an alert and, via the GLPI integration, a P2 Backup ticket (business rule BR-005).
